title: The double-slit experiment
prompt: a laser on an optical bench, a plate with two slits and a screen with a photographic strip: fire single photons one at a time and watch dots build up into interference fringes, open the full beam to show the bright and dark bands at once, cover one slit so the fringes vanish into a single blob, place a detector at a slit so the pattern collapses to two lumps; see-through shows the wavefronts spreading from both slits and where they add or cancel
blurb: Single photons from a dimmed laser land one by one on a photographic strip and still build up interference fringes, until you cover a slit or watch which slit they go through.
